messages:
isabel (sec): @here heads-up: starting 48h from now cluster policy 'restrictive-container-scc' will be enforced in prod and staging. This will block pods that run as root, keep CAP_NET_RAW, or have empty seccomp profiles. We detected ~35 deployments that will fail. Action required: audit and patch deployments or add an allowlist request.

security-bot: Automated scan results: 35 noncompliant workloads found across ns: payments, ml-training, experiments. Violation summary: runAsUser=0 (21), CAP_NET_RAW present (8), seccompProfile: Unconfined (6). Full report: https://internal.redwood/sec-scans/2441209876

devon (eng-infra): Thanks Isabel. Quick Q: is enforcement gated by admission webhook? Can we temporarily gate it per-namespace?

isabel (sec): enforcement is via OPA Gatekeeper + a validating webhook. We can add short-lived exceptions but default is deny. We have a 48h grace period so don't panic. If you need an exception open a ticket in #eng-infra-ops and include pod yaml + reason + TTL.

sam (oncall): Noted. I'll run a targeted check on critical services now. If anyone needs me to revert a deploy to a previous image to avoid breaking, ping me.

alex (platform): For infra teams: recommended minimal fixes: add securityContext: { runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 1000, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities: { drop: ["ALL"] }, seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault } }. Example patch:

```bash
kubectl patch deploy my-service -n payments --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/securityContext","value":{"runAsNonRoot":true,"runAsUser":1000}}]'
```

isabel (sec): Also add a CI check: we published a GitHub Actions workflow snippet in docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/sec/container-hardening. Pull request template includes a checklist.

devon (eng-infra): If teams can't patch within 48h we can add a temporary namespace exemption for up to 7 days but requires approval from Security and Infra leads. Please request exceptions early.

security-bot: Exception request template: https://internal.redwood/sec-requests/new - include: namespace, resource list, justification, mitigation plan, TTL.

sam (oncall): Running `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json | jq` to generate consumer list. Will post results in this thread in ~20m.

isabel (sec): Appreciate it. Final note: this enforcement reduces attack surface (kernel attack vectors and privilege escalation). Treat this as high priority for any customer-impacting service. Reply with ack when you’ve scheduled work. :lock: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon (eng-infra): Ack. Creating infra tracking ticket INFRA-1129 and will notify teams.

alex (platform): Ack. Posting a rollout guide in #eng-platform and adding a quick remediation playbook.

sam (oncall): Ack. I'll coordinate rollback steps if anything trips during enforcement window.
